culprit_citations.quoted_text: Par amount is presented for debt investments, while the number of shares or units owned is presented for equity investments. Par amount is denominated in U.S. Dollars ("$" or "USD") unless otherwise noted, Euro ("EUR"), Great British Pound ("GBP"), or Canadian dollar ("CAD").
Investment | Reference Rate and Spread | Interest Rate (3) | Maturity Date | Par Amount/ Shares (4) | Cost (5) | Fair Value | Percentage of Net Assets

findings.detail: The CAD denomination disclosed in source applies to par amount under footnote (4), while fair value is a separate dollar-denominated SOI column; fair_value_currency should not be CAD.

rationale: FX02 is a Class 1 currency/unit check on fair_value_currency. The raw SOI structure separates Par Amount/Shares (4) from Cost and Fair Value, and footnote (4) explicitly describes denomination only for par amount/shares. The flagged CAD value therefore appears to be propagated from the par amount denomination into the fair value currency field, while the fair value column remains presented in dollars.
